segments.he:
א.

אִשָּׁה כְּשֶׁרָה מְטַהֶרֶת הַבַּיִת מִצָּרָעַת.
segments.en:
An upright woman purifies the house from leprosy (t.n.

in Likutay Moharan 21 Rabbi Nachman reveals that leprosy can refer to the shutout of supernal light).
